# DRI avatars (legacy)

Roadmap photos now live under **`src/assets/avatars/`** and are bundled by Vite (`andrey.png`, `courtney.jpeg`, `tracey.jpeg`). See `ganttAvatarSrcForDri` in `src/data/ganttData.ts`.

This `public/assets/avatars/` folder is kept for any other static assets that must be served from the site root.
